name: Strings of Pain
source:
Mieko is a regular student in a prestigious high school. She dates Shinji, one of the most popular boys in her class. They take a normal life, until Mieko begins to have intrusive thoughts in the form of hallucinations and dreams, showing her boyfriend suffering. But how bad can the dreams get? And to what extent will they affect her... and Shinji? 

[From [url=https://epschy.itch.io/strings-of-pain]itch.io[/url]]
